text: These pro- duced the diagnosis of coronary sclerosis.
text_raw:
These pro-
duced the diagnosis of coronary sclerosis.

text: Unfortunately the patient was never able to lay his work aside but has been subject to constant burdens, particularly in recent times, and to major upsets and irri- tations.
text_raw:
Unfortunately the patient
was never able to lay his work aside but has been subject to constant
burdens, particularly in recent times, and to major upsets and irri-
tations.

text: These last ﬁ ve years he never went to bed before four or ﬁ ve AM., as his ﬁ nal conferences and labours were never ﬁ nished before then.
text_raw:
These last ﬁ ve years he never went to bed before four or ﬁ ve
AM., as his ﬁ nal conferences and labours were never ﬁ nished before
then.

text: He had become a stranger to the idea of going for walks, as he became accustomed to taking only ﬁ fteen minutes’ fresh air a day for months on end, spending the rest of his time without natural light in bunkers!
text_raw:
He had become a stranger to the idea of going for walks, as he
became accustomed to taking only ﬁ fteen minutes’ fresh air a day
for months on end, spending the rest of his time without natural
light in bunkers!

text: Nevertheless I managed by injecting a lot of  percent glucose – in intravenous shots of  cc at a time – often for months on end, and by adding iodine from time to time (in the form of Septoiod), to ward oﬀ an even more rapid progression of the coronary sclero- sis.
text_raw:
Nevertheless I managed by injecting a lot of  percent glucose –
in intravenous shots of  cc at a time – often for months on end,
and by adding iodine from time to time (in the form of Septoiod),
to ward oﬀ an even more rapid progression of the coronary sclero-
sis.

text: T o fortify him further I frequently administered Vitamultin-Cal- cium (which contains vitamins C, B  and nicotinamide and calcium, et cetera), Glyconorm (the extract of cardiac muscles, suprarenal gland cortex, liver and pancreas) and from time to time liver extract too.
text_raw:
T o fortify him further I frequently administered Vitamultin-Cal-
cium (which contains vitamins C, B
 and nicotinamide and calcium,
et cetera), Glyconorm (the extract of cardiac muscles, suprarenal
gland cortex, liver and pancreas) and from time to time liver extract
too.

text: The patient lives a vegetarian existence without nicotine and alcohol, with restricted liquid intake.
text_raw:
The patient lives a vegetarian existence without nicotine and
alcohol, with restricted liquid intake.

text: Iodine-Calcium-Diuretin was not administered, as his stomach is hypersensitive and reacts vio- lently with spasms.
text_raw:
Iodine-Calcium-Diuretin was
not administered, as his stomach is hypersensitive and reacts vio-
lently with spasms.

text: So far there have been no anginal complaints.
text_raw: So far there have been no anginal complaints.

text: I would be very grateful to you for any opinion and suggestions for further treat- ment, if you consider a change is called for.
text_raw:
I would be very
grateful to you for any opinion and suggestions for further treat-
ment, if you consider a change is called for.

text: I did recommend mas- sage, but this was not permitted.
text_raw:
I did recommend mas-
sage, but this was not permitted.

text: As I informed you earlier, I had my ﬁ rst serious attack of angina pectoris after a miserable airplane ﬂ ight, with a T that stayed strongly nega- tive for some time, and then later regulated again.
text_raw:
As I
informed you earlier, I had my ﬁ rst serious attack of angina pectoris
after a miserable airplane ﬂ ight, with a T that stayed strongly nega-
tive for some time, and then later regulated again.

text: The QRS open- ing is gradually getting bigger, and due to the constant responsibil- ity and several hateful intrigues against me, I have begun feeling constantly a little depressed.
text_raw:
The QRS open-
ing is gradually getting bigger, and due to the constant responsibil-
ity and several hateful intrigues against me, I have begun feeling
constantly a little depressed.

text: I perspire at night and get breathless easily.
text_raw:
I perspire at night and get breathless
easily.

text: Also the edemas on my lower legs have become more pro- nounced, so I have been getting massages every few days now.
text_raw:
Also the edemas on my lower legs have become more pro-
nounced, so I have been getting massages every few days now.

text: Alti- tudes of oo to , meters do not agree with me at all, and that goes for air that is low in oxygen too.
text_raw:
Alti-
tudes of oo to , meters do not agree with me at all, and that
goes for air that is low in oxygen too.

text: I have had to have a series of Glucadenose injections more than once already, and things go bet- ter after that; but as my burdens increase so it becomes evident that I am not getting permanently better.
text_raw:
I have had to have a series of
Glucadenose injections more than once already, and things go bet-
ter after that; but as my burdens increase so it becomes evident that
I am not getting permanently better.

text: There are unfortunately cer- tain reasons why I cannot take time oﬀ .
text_raw:
There are unfortunately cer-
tain reasons why I cannot take time oﬀ .

text: A few months ago after a sudden upset I had a haemorrhage be- hind my left eye, but this was rapidly reabsorbed.
text_raw:
A few months ago after a sudden upset I had a haemorrhage be-
hind my left eye, but this was rapidly reabsorbed.

text: In the spring of  I had a major upset which caused a frontal haemorrhage which however rapidly got better. but since then some of my lesser mus- cles have tired more easily.
text_raw:
In the spring of
 I had a major upset which caused a frontal haemorrhage which
however rapidly got better. but since then some of my lesser mus-
cles have tired more easily.

text: A month ago I attended the funeral of my brother at Bad Nauheim for a day – he died of an apoplexy at  – but I had no time to come and see you as I had to get back urgently.
text_raw:
A month ago I attended the funeral of my brother at Bad Nauheim
for a day – he died of an apoplexy at  – but I had no time to come
and see you as I had to get back urgently.

text: Perhaps I will soon be able to call on you.
text_raw:
Perhaps I will soon be able
to call on you.

text: I would be indebted to you if you would tell me without pulling any punches how you interpret my case too, and give me your sug- gestions.
text_raw:
I would be indebted to you if you would tell me without pulling
any punches how you interpret my case too, and give me your sug-
gestions.

text: I’ve been taking liquid Cardiazol for some weeks and lodine- Calcium-Diuretin.
text_raw:
I’ve been taking liquid Cardiazol for some weeks and lodine-
Calcium-Diuretin.

text: Thanking you in advance and wishing you all the best, Heil Hitler!
text_raw:
Thanking you in advance and wishing you all the best,
Heil Hitler!

text: Yours, M[orell] P.S.:
text_raw:
Yours, M[orell]
P.S.:

text_raw:
Please enclose your account and include your two previous

text_raw:
Hand your opinion to the courier and give

text_raw:
Please accept my heartfelt con-

I would be interested to learn
whether it was an apoplexy or a sudden cardiac failure, as he had
been suﬀ ering from angina for a number of years.

each week?

Taking a day oﬀ like that often does more good than all
